$comment: English overlay of content/ui.json (merged over the Spanish base at build time; see scripts/content/load.js). Proper names and terms are kept in Spanish on purpose: ROYAT, ¡Preciosooo!, Jarana, Vaquería, Terno, Bomba, El Torito, place names, record and song titles, Fovi Rodríguez. The WhatsApp message (contact.message) stays in Spanish: it is read by the orchestra, not by the visitor.
